set.body:
Source: review of AttemptEpoch, RetrySafety, SubmissionUnavailable, and LocalProcessRunner.

Problem:
epoch fencing protects a retry transition no command currently produces, RetrySafety is declared but unread, and LocalProcessRunner appears unused. These abstractions advertise semantics the public workflow cannot exercise.

Acceptance:
- Retain AttemptEpoch only with a documented production lifecycle and either an explicit safe retry command or a clear v1 fencing role with reachable transitions.
- Consume RetrySafety in durable metadata/policy where it changes behavior, or remove it until a real consumer exists.
- Use LocalProcessRunner through a supported interpreter or delete it.
- Remove dead test-to-compile dependencies and add reachability tests for every retained transition.
set.title: P6f.14: Resolve unused retry and process abstractions
